name: vtitan-wiring-harness
description: tscircuit port of the vtitan robot wiring harness

scripts.build: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- tsci build circuit.tsx
scripts.netlist: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- tsci export circuit.tsx -f readable-netlist -o harness.netlist.txt
scripts.svg: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- tsci export circuit.tsx -f schematic-svg -o ../harness.schematic.svg && node whiten-svg.mjs
scripts.artifacts: npm run netlist && npm run svg && npm run png
